input: Sweep is too strong: make it slower to recover and a bit weaker. Blocking should chip a little more damage.

response.rationale: Reduced Sweep damage from 16 to 12.8 (-20%) and increased its recovery time from 0.38s to 0.456s (+20%) to make it slower and weaker as requested. Increased guardDamageMultiplier from 0.2 to 0.25 so blocking now chips slightly more damage (25% of incoming damage instead of 20%), making defense less safe against repeated hits.
